seoTitle: Master of Flags — Free Flag Quiz App, No Ads
metaDescription: Learn every country flag and capital with a no-ads, no-subscription quiz. Daily Challenge, streaks, capitals mode and a 250-flag encyclopedia. Free forever — start today.
heroSubhead: A geography quiz that respects you: no ads, no subscription, no account. Flags and capitals across all six regions, free forever. If you want more, Pro is one purchase you own for life.
highlights: No ads. No subscription. No account.
Free forever, Pro is a one-time purchase

features.title: Flags and capitals
features.body: Two ways to play: name the flag, or match the capital. Europe, Asia, Africa, the Americas, Oceania and the whole world. Every region and both modes stay free.

features.title: Daily Challenge
features.body: Ten questions, once a day, the same set for everyone. Shareable results, and an archive of every day you have played.

features.title: Streaks that forgive
features.body: Build a daily streak. Streak freezes mean one busy day won't erase your run.

features.title: Flag Encyclopedia
features.body: Browse roughly 250 flags and territories with capitals, country facts and the story behind each flag. Free to read, anytime.

features.title: Pro: drill what you miss
features.body: Smart Review schedules the flags you got wrong with spaced repetition. Similar Flags drills the lookalikes — Chad and Romania, Indonesia and Monaco. Hard Mode deals eight flags instead of three.

features.title: Progress you can see
features.body: XP, levels, per-region accuracy, plus Game Center leaderboards and achievements. The full Statistics dashboard is part of Pro.

howItWorks.step: Pick a region and a mode
howItWorks.body: Choose a continent or the whole world, then guess flags or match capitals. Start right away, no account.
Take the ten-question Daily Challenge, keep your streak alive, and share your score.
Unlock Pro to let Smart Review resurface the ones you miss, and to get harder rounds and full statistics.

faq.q: Is Master of Flags really free?
faq.a: Yes. Both quiz modes, all six regions, the Daily Challenge, streaks, leaderboards and the full encyclopedia are free, with no ads and no account. You can play forever without paying.

faq.q: What does Pro unlock and how much is it?
faq.a: Pro is a single $4.99 one-time purchase. It adds Hard Mode (eight flags a round instead of three), Smart Review with spaced repetition, the Similar Flags drill for lookalike flags, replay of any past Daily Challenge, a full Statistics dashboard, and five streak freezes a month instead of one. There is no subscription and no second tier.

faq.q: Are there any ads or subscriptions?
faq.a: No. There are no banner ads, no video ads, and no recurring charges. The only optional payment is the one-time Pro unlock.

faq.q: Does Master of Flags work offline?
faq.a: Yes. The quiz and encyclopedia run on your device. You only need a connection for Game Center leaderboards and achievements.
Your data stays on your device. Nothing is collected and nothing is tracked.

faq.q: I bought the app years ago when it was paid. Do I have to pay again?
faq.a: No. Early buyers are grandfathered into Pro automatically, free, forever. Tap Restore Purchases to bring it back on any new device.

faq.q: Which devices and languages are supported?
faq.a: iPhone and iPad running iOS or iPadOS 17.4 or later. The whole app — not just the App Store page — is translated into English, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, and Simplified and Traditional Chinese.

faq.q: How many flags can I learn?
faq.a: Roughly 250 flags and territories, each with its capital and country details in the encyclopedia.
